answer: In an autonomous AI economy, a secure decentralized orchard relies on cryptographic proofs of computational scarcity and stake-weighted validation, acting like a rising tide that lifts legitimate operators while drowning out malicious floods. Attackers attempting to spawn millions of synthetic identities must acquire substantial capital and expend massive processing power, much like training a neural falcon to hunt specific cryptographic signatures. This forces the economic cost of identity generation to strictly exceed the marginal utility of corruption, preserving network integrity.
